name: Meeting Finder
description: Detects when a Webex meeting starts in a watched space and resolves a ready-to-use join link. Does not join meetings itself — see plugins/webex for the existing channel this shares its webhook receiver with.

accessToken.description: OAuth user access token. Required — bot tokens cannot read the meetings resource, same constraint as channels.webex.accessToken.

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for renewing accessToken

webhookUrl.description: Public URL for receiving the meetings/started webhook POSTs

webhookSecret.description: HMAC-SHA1 secret for verifying webhook signatures

roomIds.description: Spaces to resolve join links for. Empty = all spaces the account can see.
